`h2o_http2_stream_has_pending_data(stream)` reads `stream->_data.size` which is beyond the partial allocation. `_data` is a `H2O_VECTOR(h2o_iovec_t)` which has `size` (size_t, 8 bytes) and `capacity` (size_t, 8 bytes).
